The '''D'Aelgoth sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Xaverri]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once conned most of the life savings from the Assistant Secretary to the sector's [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] and framed him for [[Treason/Legends|treason]].
